The covering follows the body outline. Bilaterally symmetrical, recognizable limbs, visible sense organs. Habitat cue (river forest): dark back and light belly (mild countershading). Prosaic detail: natural lighting, feet in firm contact with the ground with a soft shadow, normal wear on hooves, claws and skin. One creature, full body, side three-quarter view, plain light background, natural history illustration.

spark_open.description: The creature is shown in right-facing side profile against a plain off-white background with a soft shadow beneath its feet. It has a low, elongated, quadrupedal body with a broad, flat, pale gray head that has large round dark eyes with pale blue-gray irises, small nostrils, and a slightly upturned closed mouth. Six pink, feathery, stalk-like external gills extend from the neck just behind the head. The entire dorsal surface from the back of the neck over the back and sides and onto the long tapering tail is covered in overlapping large, rounded, dark brown to tan scales with lighter edges and concentric ridges, while the ventral belly, limbs, and head are pale, smooth, and wrinkled with transverse folds. It stands on four short, thick, stout limbs ending in broad five-toed clawed feet, with the tail extending to the left and cropped by the image edge.
